profile.summary: Ball for Life Oakland is a company in Oakland, California that offers youth programs built around sports and play. Its programs include mindful sports electives in basketball and soccer, after-school programs, recess enrichment, and professional development for educators. It says the programs support students' social-emotional learning and wellness.
